description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Grid_Polar, which extends Image_Graph_Grid, and is responsible for rendering a polar grid in a graph plotting library. It includes methods for constructing the grid and outputting the grid as ellipses on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid_Polar
classes.description: A class for rendering a polar grid in a graph plotting library, extending the base Image_Graph_Grid class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the polar grid and sets the line style to light grey.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the polar grid as a series of ellipses based on the primary axis and its labels.
